title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.eq_zero_of_lcm_eq_zero
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.eq_zero_of_lcm_eq_zero` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m.lcm n = 0 → m = 0 ∨ n = 0
